summary: WorkReadPort::list_tasks scope path (active/attention/history/all): the classified-roots CTE from WorkStore._list_task_scope, native variant (no external workflow joins, delivery projection NULL), keyset-paged by (list_updated_at, id) descending.
signature: pub(crate) fn list_scope(store: &crate::work_store::PgWorkStore, project_alias: &str, scope: &str, limit: i64, cursor_task_id: Option<uuid::Uuid>) -> Result<forge_work::TaskPage, forge_work::WorkError>;
responsibilities: In one transaction: when cursor_task_id is present, run the classified CTE (pinned in the pattern) + SELECT id, list_updated_at FROM classified WHERE id=$3; no anchor -> rejected(400, invalid_request).

Run the CTE + the page SELECT pinned in the pattern: WHERE ($3='all' OR task_scope=$3) AND ($4::timestamptz IS NULL OR (list_updated_at,id)<($4::timestamptz,$5::uuid)) ORDER BY list_updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $6 with limit+1.

Shape the first `limit` rows with work_rows::summary (the classified row carries every summary column plus computed workflow_required/workflow_phase). next_cursor as in the raw path. Scope counts and the delivery projection are not carried by the Rust TaskPage type (documented v1 subset).
invariants: The classification CASE is pinned verbatim; do not simplify it - portal scope membership depends on its exact precedence (delivery scope, terminal phases, escalated/disabled attention, workflow_required attention, raw-status fallback).
Only workflow roots are listed: (w.workflow_id IS NULL OR t.id = w.root_task_id).
